reading.title: Breakfast at Home
reading.text: My name is Lan. Every morning I am very hungry, so I go to the kitchen and cook breakfast. I usually make rice with chicken and some vegetables. My brother only wants a drink, a glass of milk. On Sundays we go to a small café. We look at the menu for a long time, then I order a bowl of noodle soup. It is always delicious!
reading.vi: Tên mình là Lan. Sáng nào mình cũng rất đói, nên mình vào bếp nấu bữa sáng. Mình thường làm cơm với thịt gà và ít rau. Anh trai mình chỉ muốn một đồ uống, một cốc sữa. Chủ nhật, nhà mình đi một quán cà phê nhỏ. Tụi mình xem thực đơn rất lâu, rồi mình gọi một bát phở. Lúc nào cũng ngon tuyệt!

reading.title: Minh's Day
reading.text: Minh's alarm rings at six o'clock. He gets up early, has a shower and brushes his teeth. He usually takes the bus to school at seven. After school he does his homework in the afternoon. In the evening he is tired, so he goes to bed at ten. At the weekend Minh gets up late, at nine or ten o'clock, and he never does homework on Saturday morning.

reading.text: On Saturdays we often have a picnic in the park. We take some bread, some cheese and a big bottle of water. We don't take any cake. reading.title: A Surprise Party
reading.text: It was my mother's birthday, but nobody said anything in the morning. She thought everyone forgot. In the evening she came home and the house was dark. “Is anyone here?” she asked. Nothing. Then somebody turned on the light and everybody shouted, “Happy birthday!” Someone brought a big cake. Everything was perfect. She said, “I have something to say: thank you!”
reading.vi: Hôm đó là sinh nhật mẹ, nhưng buổi sáng không ai nói gì. Mẹ nghĩ mọi người quên rồi. Buổi tối mẹ về nhà và nhà tối om. “Có ai ở đây không?” mẹ hỏi. Không có gì. Rồi ai đó bật đèn và mọi người hét lên: “Chúc mừng sinh nhật!” Có người mang tới một chiếc bánh lớn. Mọi thứ thật hoàn hảo. Mẹ nói: “Mẹ có điều muốn nói: cảm ơn cả nhà!”

reading.text: I can't find my cat, Mimi. She isn't in the kitchen. She isn't on the sofa or under the bed. Is she behind the door? No. There is a box between the table and the chair, but she isn't in it. Then I look at the shelf above the TV. Mimi is there, next to my books! The shop opposite our house sells cat food.

Rồi mình nhìn lên cái kệ phía trên tivi. Mimi ở đó, cạnh sách của mình! Cửa hàng đối diện nhà mình bán thức ăn cho mèo.

reading.text: My friend Tom is from England. In his country people use pounds, and in the USA people use dollars. In France they use euros. Each dollar has a hundred cents. reading.title: Learning New Words
reading.text: Every day I learn five new English words. I write each word in my notebook with its meaning and an example sentence. Then I try to use the words in a short paragraph. Spelling is difficult in English, so I spell the words aloud. For example, the word “knife” has a silent K. What does “silent” mean? It means you don't say it. Every language is different, and one phrase can have two meanings.

reading.text: My family shares the housework. I help my mother in the kitchen, and my brother cleans the floor. Look at our garden! My father takes care of it very well. Sometimes my friends join us for dinner. My parents let us watch TV after we finish our homework. We have to go to bed at ten. Of course, we don't always want to, but we listen. Can you see how happy we are?

reading.title: Plans for the Future
reading.text: In the past I wanted to be a doctor, but at present I want to be a teacher. The reason is simple: I love children. My teacher gave me good advice: “Take part in school activities.” So now I help younger students in the reading club. It is my favourite activity. This period of my life is busy, but I am happy. I hope the future is bright.
